name: unbound-ai-mobile
description: Native Android and iOS shell for UNBOUND AI

scripts.assets:android: npm run verify:assets && npx capacitor-assets generate --android --iconBackgroundColor '#030810' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#030810' --splashBackgroundColor '#030810' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#030810'
scripts.assets:ios: npm run verify:assets && npx capacitor-assets generate --ios --iconBackgroundColor '#030810' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#030810' --splashBackgroundColor '#030810' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#030810'
scripts.assets: npm run assets:android && npm run assets:ios
scripts.prepare:native: npm run sync && npm run assets && npm run configure:links && npm run configure:permissions
